book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhariiseemerya kwita Yɨɨsu
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aamarirɨ kʉgamba amangʼana gayo gʉʉsi, akabhʉʉrɨra abhɨɨga bhaazɨ,
“Chɨmbu mwɨzɨ, zɨraahɨtɨ sikʉ ibhɨrɨ, tʉrabha ni isigukuru yɨ Ɨpasaka.
Urusikʉ ruyo, Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ arahurukibhwa, korereke iitwɨ kʉmʉsarabha.”
Mmbe, ribhaga riyo, abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani
na abhakaruka bha Abhayaahudi bhakiibhiringa munyumba ya kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ, iriina ryazɨ Kayaafa.
Muyo, bhakagambana chɨmbu bharaamugwatɨ Yɨɨsu kwa mbisi, korereke bhamwitɨ.
Nawe bhakabhuga, “Tʉtaaza kokora ganʉ ribhaga ryi isigukuru yɨ Ɨpasaka, abhaatʉ bhataaza kokora ɨkɨmpʉgɨ.”
Ʉmʉkari arahaka Yɨɨsu amaguta
Neho Yɨɨsu akaja mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Bhɨtaniya, akiikara munyumba ya Simʉʉni wʉnʉ aarɨ ne ebhegenge.
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aarɨ kwigari, akaaza ʉmʉkari wʉmwɨ kwewe ani ichupa ɨnzʉmu ya amaguta ganʉ gaarɨ gi iguri ikʉrʉ na garareetya bhwaheene. Ʉmʉkari wuyo akamwitʉrʉrɨra Yɨɨsu kumutwɨ.
Hanʉ abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhaarʉʉzɨ gayo, bhakiigatana. Bhakabhuga, “Ndora ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ arasarya amaguta ga riguri ikʉrʉbhu?
Yaarɨ bhwaheene amaguta ganʉ gangaguriibhwɨ kuzimpirya nzaru bhʉkʉngʼu, na kʉhaabhwa abhahabhɨ!”
Yɨɨsu akoobhoora ganʉ bhaarɨ bhakwiseega, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ndora mʉranyaacha ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ? Ewe ankʉrɨɨrɨ ringʼana rizʉmu bhʉkʉngʼu.
Abhahabhɨ mʉnabhʉ sikʉ zʉʉsi, nawe inyɨ nɨtakʉbha hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ ibhaga ryʉsi.
Ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ anyiitiriirɨ amaguta, korereke akonze ʉmʉbhɨrɨ gwanɨ ku kubhiikwa kwanɨ.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, hʉhʉʉsi mubhyarʉ hanʉ abhaatʉ bhakʉbha bhararwaza Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu, bharabha bharagamba rɨnʉ ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ aakʉrirɨ, kumuhiita.”
Yuuda Isikariyʉʉti ariisirirya kumwichʉra Yɨɨsu
Mmbe Yuuda Isikariyʉʉti, wʉmwɨ wa abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ, akaja kʉbhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani,
akabhabhuurya, “Mʉrandɨhakɨ nɨraamugwatyɨ Yɨɨsu mʉmabhoko gaanyu?” Akʉmara bhakamʉrɨha zimpirya merongo ɨtatʉ.
Kʉtangɨra ribhaga riyo, Yuuda Isikariyʉʉti akatanga komohya umweya ʉmʉzʉmu gu ukumwichʉra.
Yɨɨsu ararya Ɨpasaka na abhɨɨga bhaazɨ
Kurusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtangɨ rwi isigukuru yɨ Ɨmɨkaatɨ Gɨnʉ Gɨtarɨ Mitunduuru, abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu bhakaja kwawɨ, bhakamubhuurya, “Oreenda tujɨ hayi tokokorere ahagero hʉ ʉkʉrɨɨra Ɨpasaka?”

Yɨɨsu akabhaha iriina ryʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ omorebhe akabhuga, “Mujɨ mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu kʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo, mʉmʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ, ‘Umwija atutumirɨ na arabhuga, “Ribhaga ryanɨ rɨrɨ haguhɨ. Inyɨ na abhɨɨga bhaanɨ tʉrarya Ɨpasaka munyumba yaazʉ.”’”
Abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakakora gʉʉsi chɨmbu Yɨɨsu aabhatumirɨ, bhakatenga ibhyakurya bhyɨ Ɨpasaka.
Hanʉ ryahikirɨ rigoroobha, Yɨɨsu na abhɨɨga bhaazɨ ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ bhakiikara kurya ibhyakurya.
Hanʉ bhaarɨ bhararya, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, wʉmwɨ waanyu aranyiichʉra.”
Abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakarumɨka bhʉkʉngʼu, bhakatanga kumubhuurya wʉmwɨ wʉmwɨ, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, nangʉ niinyɨ?”
Yɨɨsu akagarukirya, “Nɨ‑wʉnʉ akokorya hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ mʉbhakuri, newe araanyiichʉrɨ.
Maheene Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ araja kukwa, chɨmbu Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu gakubhuga igʉrʉ waazɨ. Nawe, horeera kʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ariichʉrɨ Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ! Yaarɨ hakɨrɨku kwewe atangibhwirwɨ!”
Mmbe, Yuuda wʉnʉ aatɨɨrɨ Yɨɨsu mʉmabhoko ga abhabhisa, wʉʉsi akamubhuurya, “Umwija, nangʉ niinyɨ?” Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Naawɨ ubhugirɨ.”
Hanʉ bhaarɨ bhararya, Yɨɨsu akagega ʉmʉkaatɨ, akabhʉʉrɨra Mungu, azʉmiryɨ. Akagusunyura, akabhaha abhɨɨga bhaazɨ, akabhuga, “Mogege muryɨ, gʉnʉ negwe ʉmʉbhɨrɨ gwanɨ.”
Akʉmara, akagega ekekombe chi idivaayi, akabhʉʉrɨra Mungu, azʉmiryɨ, akabhaha arabhuga, “Mogege, munywɨ imwʉsi.
Ganʉ nego amasaahɨ gaanɨ gʉ ʉbhʉragɨ,
ganʉ gakwitɨka igʉrʉ wa abhaatʉ bhaaru ku kuruushwa ʉbhʉbhɨ.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, nɨtakunywa naatu idivaayi kuhika hanʉ nikunywa bhuhya hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Bhaabha.”
Akʉmara bhakɨɨmba iryɨmbʉ ryu ukukumya Mungu. Bhakabhʉʉka hayo, bhakaja kʉkɨgʉrʉ chɨ Ɨmɨzɨyituuni.
Yɨɨsu ararora kʉbha Peetero aramwanga

Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra abhɨɨga bhaazɨ, “Ubhutikʉ bhwa reero, imwɨ bhʉʉsi mʉrangʼosa na kuntiga. Ɨrabhabhu, chɨmbu Mungu aagambirɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, ‘Nɨramwita umuriisha, na riribhita rya zɨngʼʉndu zaazɨ rɨranyaragana.’
Nawe hanʉ nikuryʉka, nɨrabhakangatɨra kuja Gariraaya.”
Peetero akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Nangabha bhʉʉsi bharakutiga, inyɨ nɨtakukutiga zee!”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Nɨrakʉbhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ubhutikʉ bhwa reero, ekorokoome ɨkɨɨrɨ kʉgamba, ʉrabha ʉnyangirɨ manga katatʉ.”
Peetero akamʉgarukirya, “Nangabha kukwa, nikwɨ hamwɨmwɨ na naawɨ, nɨtakukwanga zee!” Abhɨɨga abhandɨ bhʉʉsi, bhakabhuga ɨbhuɨbhu.
Yɨɨsu arasabha Gɨtisɨmanɨ
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akaja na abhɨɨga bhaazɨ mubhusitaani yɨnʉ ikubhirikirwa Gɨtisɨmanɨ. Akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Mwikarɨ hinga hanʉ, nijɨ kʉsabha Mungu.”
Akagega Peetero hamwɨmwɨ na abhaana bhabhɨrɨ bha Zebhedaayo. Akatanga kurumɨka na kʉnyaaka bhʉkʉngʼu mokoro yaazɨ,
akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ekoro yaanɨ irumikirɨ bhʉkʉngʼu ekerengo chu ukukwa. Mwikarɨ hanʉ, motengeeze hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ.”

Akiisuka embere hasuuhu, akagwa kibhumɨɨrɨ, akasabha Mungu arabhuga, “Bhaabha, arɨɨbhɨ ɨratʉrɨkana, nɨrakʉsabha unduushiryɨ ekekombe chɨ ɨnyaakʉ kɨnʉ! Ɨtarɨ chɨmbu inyɨ nikwenda, nawe gakorwe chɨmbu awɨ ukwenda.”
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akagarʉka kʉbhɨɨga bhaazɨ, akabhabhona bhahindiirɨ. Akabhuurya Peetero, “Nangʉ, mʉtamirwɨ kotengeeza hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ nʉʉrʉ kwɨ ɨɨsa yɨmwɨ?
Motengeeze na kʉsabha, mʉtaaza kusikɨra mubhitiimotiimo. Ekoro iriisirirya, nawe ʉmʉbhɨrɨ nɨ‑mʉnyʉʉhɨrɨru.”
Yɨɨsu akabhatiga, akaja iyo rwa kabhɨrɨ, akasabha arabhuga, “Bhaabha, arɨɨbhɨ ɨnyaakʉ yɨnʉ ɨtakʉtʉrɨkana kurwa kwa niinyɨ, gakorwe chɨmbu ukwenda.”
Mmbe, hanʉ aagarukirɨ kwabhʉ, akabhona kwikɨ bhahindiirɨ, kʉ kʉbha amɨɨsʉ gaabhʉ gaarɨ maritʉ.
Akabhatiga, akaja kʉsabha rwa katatʉ, akagarʉkɨra kʉgamba amangʼana garyagarya.
Akʉmara akagarʉka naatu kwa abhɨɨga bhaazɨ, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Nangʉ muhindɨrɨ mwoyeere, rora! Ribhaga rihikirɨ rɨnʉ Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ aragwatwa na kuhirwa mʉmabhoko ga abhakʉri bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ.
Mʉbhʉʉkɨ, tujɨ. Rora, wʉnʉ akunyiichʉra arɨ haguhɨ.”
Yɨɨsu aragwatwa

Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aarɨ akɨɨrɨ aragamba gayo, hayohayo Yuuda, wʉmwɨ wa abhɨɨga bhaazɨ ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ, akaaza hamwɨmwɨ na riribhita ikʉrʉ rya abhaatʉ bha amasabha na amarungu. Riribhita riyo rɨkatumwa na abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani na abhakaruka bha Abhayaahudi.
Yuuda wʉnʉ aamwichurirɨ Yɨɨsu, aarɨ akangatirɨ kʉragɨrɨra abhaatʉ bhayo ichɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ. Akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ nɨraahumbatɨ, newe mugwatɨ.”
Hayohayo Yuuda akaja kwa Yɨɨsu, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Umwija, morembe!” Akʉmara akamuhumbata.
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Mʉsaani waanɨ, kora kɨnʉ kɨkʉrɨɨtirɨ.” Mmbe abhaatʉ bhayo bhakiisuka, bhakamugwata Yɨɨsu.
Neho wʉmwɨ mʉbhanʉ bhaarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na Yɨɨsu, akasohora risabha ryazɨ, akatɨna ʉkʉtwɨ kwa mbʉʉsa wa kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ kutu.
Nawe Yɨɨsu akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Garucha risabha ahagero haaho, kʉ kʉbha bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakugwata risabha korereke bhiitɨ, bharakwa kwa risabha!
Nangʉ, ʉtɨɨzɨ kʉbha nɨranaja kʉsabha ʉbhʉsakirya kwa Bhaabha, nawe aratʉra kʉntʉmɨra bhamaraika kʉkɨra amaribhita amakʉrʉ ikumi na abhɨrɨ?
Hanʉ nangakʉrirɨbhu, garahikabhwɨ ganʉ gaandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu kʉbha, nɨmbu gakwenderwa kʉhʉrʉka?”
Neho Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉrɨra riribhita riyo, “Ndora mwizirɨ na amasabha na amarungu kungwata, nkina inyɨ nɨ‑mʉsaakuri? Zisikʉ zʉʉsi naarɨ niriija mwihekaaru, nawe mʉtaangwatirɨ!
Nawe gʉʉsi gakʉrirwɨ, korereke gahikɨ ganʉ abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhaandikirɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu.” Mmbe, abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhʉʉsi bhakaryara, bhakamutiga.
Yɨɨsu mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwi ichandarʉ ɨkɨkʉrʉ cha Abhayaahudi
Mmbe, bhanʉ bhaamugwatirɨ Yɨɨsu, bhakamuhira kwa Kayaafa, kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ. Munyumba yaazɨ, ɨnʉ bhaarɨ bhiibhiringirɨ abhiija bhi imigirʉ ja Musa na abhakaruka bha Abhayaahudi.
Peetero aarɨ aramutuna Yɨɨsu kwa kore, kuhika mukisikʉ chi inyumba ya kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ. Akasikɨra mʉʉsi, akiikara hamwɨmwɨ na abhariibhi korereke arore chɨmbu ikiina cha Yɨɨsu kɨkʉbha.
Abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani ni ichandarʉ
chʉsi, bhakamohya obhomenyeekererya bhwʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ korereke bhabhone ɨnzɨra yu ukwita Yɨɨsu.
Bhakaaza abhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ bhaaru, nawe bhatabhwɨnɨ.
Akʉmara bhakaaza abhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhabhɨrɨ, bhakabhuga, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akabhuga, ‘Nɨranaja kwasha rihekaaru rya Mungu na kuryʉmbaka kwa sikʉ isatʉ.’ ”
Akʉmara kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ akiimɨɨrɨra, akabhuurya Yɨɨsu, “Awɨɨ, ʉtakʉgarukirya ingʼana ryʉryʉsi? Amangʼana ganʉ abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakʉkʉgamba?”
Nawe Yɨɨsu akakira kiri. Kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ wuyo akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Nɨrakwirahirya kuriina rya Mungu wʉ ʉbhʉhʉru, ʉtʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ arɨɨbhɨ awɨ naawɨ Kiriisitʉ, Umwana wa Mungu.”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Naawɨ ʉgambirɨ. Nawe nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, kʉtangɨra nangʉ, mʉrarora Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ ikɨɨrɨ ʉrʉbhaara rwu ubhuryʉ rwa Mungu wa Amanaga.
Na mʉramorora araaza mʉmasaarʉ kurwa mwisaarʉ.”
Mmbe, hanʉ kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ iigwirɨ amangʼana gayo, akatarandʉra amiibhoho gaazɨ, akabhuga, “Arɨgirɨ Mungu! Nɨ‑bhamenyeekereryakɨ bhanʉ tukwenda? Mwigwirɨ abheene chɨmbu akorega Mungu!
Imwɨ mʉrabhugabhwɨ?” Bhakamʉgarukirya, “Areenderwa iitwɨ!”
Akʉmara, bhakamutwɨra amatɨ mubhushʉ, bhakamotema ibhikundi. Abhandɨ bhakamotema amagʉʉhu,
na kʉmʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Awɨ Kiriisitʉ, orootorere, nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ wʉnʉ akʉtɨmirɨ?”
Peetero araanga Yɨɨsu
Mmbe, ribhaga riyoriyo, Peetero aarɨ iikɨɨrɨ igʉtʉ mukisikʉ hayo. Neho omohocha wʉmwɨ wɨ ɨkɨkari akamujaku, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Na naawɨ waarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na Yɨɨsu wa Gariraaya.”
Peetero akaanga mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi, akabhuga, “Nɨtɨɨzɨ ganʉ ukubhuga!”
Hanʉ aarɨ akurwa mukisikʉ, omohocha ʉwʉndɨ wɨ ɨkɨkari akamorora, akabhabhʉʉrɨra bhanʉ bhaareho hayo, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na Yɨɨsu wa Nazarɨɨti.”
Peetero akaanga kwa kwirahɨra, “Nɨtamwɨzɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo!”

Ibhaga isuuhu rɨkahɨta, abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhiimiiriirɨ hayo, bhakabhʉʉrɨra Peetero, “Maheene, awɨ nɨ‑wʉmwɨ wa bhanʉ bharɨ hamwɨmwɨ na Yɨɨsu. Nʉʉrʉ ʉkʉgamba kwazʉ koreerekenʼya kʉbha ʉrarwa Gariraaya!”
Peetero akatanga kwihiima bhʉkʉngʼu, akiirahɨra, “Nɨtamwɨzɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo!” Hayohayo, ekorokoome ɨkagamba.
Neho Peetero akahiita amangʼana ganʉ Yɨɨsu aamubhuuriirɨ, “Ekorokoome ɨkɨɨrɨ kʉgamba, ʉrabha ʉnyangirɨ manga katatʉ.” Akʉmara, akahʉrʉka igʉtʉ, akatanga kʉrɨra kwi isʉngʉ ihaari.
